name: Astra Microwave Products Ltd
title: Astra Microwave Products Ltd - 532493 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Defence electronics firm guides FY27 revenue growth of 15-20% (INR1,300-1,400 crore) with INR2,141 crore standalone order book; capex stays at INR40-50 crore a year, so the read is execution and cash, not capacity expansion.

capex.quote: every year, we are augmenting the existing requirements by spending close to about INR40 crores, INR50 crores. So that will continue.

triggers.label: Operating cash flow INR370 crore vs -INR99 crore
triggers.quote: resulting in operating cash flow of INR370 crores compared to minus INR99 crores as of last year.

triggers.label: FY27 revenue growth 15-20% reaffirmed
triggers.quote: reaffirm our FY27 top line growth at 15% to 20% rate, with a potential for much stronger growth over the coming years.

triggers.label: Export margin ~40-45% on value-add orders
triggers.quote: the value add is much higher than the regular exports that were recorded in the previous periods.

triggers.label: Radar programs slipping to FY30-31
triggers.quote: we instead of FY28-FY29 may go up to FY30-FY31.

guidance.quote: reaffirm our FY27 top line growth at 15% to 20% rate
we have planned to book sales of INR1300 crores to INR1400 crores
we expect the minimum growth of 50% both in terms of order booking and as well as sales
we expect at least next, down the line three to four years to triple the revenue or maybe you can say up to FY30 to FY31

prior_guidance_check.quote: we achieved turnover of INR1157 crores, delivering at par with the guidance given in the beginning of the year
It surpassed the guidance. We booked orders worth of INR546 crores in the last year

red_flags.label: Order book standalone vs consolidated confusion
red_flags.quote: Yes, we have order book of INR2,141. This is order book standalone order book of Astra.

red_flags.label: Key programs (QRSAM, Uttam, Su-30) timing slipping
red_flags.quote: there are many programs got delayed for various reasons as these are all government-driven programs

red_flags.label: Working capital to rise with volumes
red_flags.quote: though the increased volumes call for higher working capital utilization, we should be able to manage within the sanctioned limits

evasions.quote: We feel that we should be doing very well by sustaining the current margins achieved by the company

evasions.topic: JV profitability gap vs earlier 10-12% PBT
evasions.quote: I think INR1 crores profit you are referring to the quarter, otherwise for the year, no, it is around close to about INR8 crores.
But we cannot comment on behalf of DRDO.
